reuse.why: One new guard, assertBankAccountNotLinked, is called by every link handler. It uses the existing APIError, db.first and the AccountSyncSource type.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link query and error live in one function. The handlers only add a call that passes their provider and account id.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers and runs before any write or sync, which matches where this tree does link validation.

scope.why: The change is limited to the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and easy to own. Because each handler must remember to call the guard (there is no common link entry point to put it in), a future provider could skip it, but that is a limit of the existing structure.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five provider link handlers go through the new guard.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts holds the 'already linked' rule (non-deleted account, same provider and account id, not the upgrading account), and linkGoCardless/SimpleFin/PluggyAi/Akahu/EnableBanking all call it.
